title: JD.com expands physical AI in logistics with 3 million robots
summary: JD.com announced a Physical AI Acceleration Plan to expand AI and robotics across its logistics operations, with a five-year target to deploy 3 million robots, 1 million autonomous vehicles, and 100,000 delivery drones. The company unveiled its industrial Wolf Robot series at JDDiscovery 2026 in Beijing.
problem_solved: Scaling logistics automation to handle massive e-commerce fulfillment demands efficiently.
why_valuable: Demonstrates commercial-scale AI/robotics deployment in real-world supply chain operations with measurable targets.
